# 2 Clement — Chapter 20 (EMET Literal)

**Source:** Codex Alexandrinus, 2 Clement 20
**Agent:** EMET (Literal)
**Date:** 2026-03-17

---

1. But do not let the vile one be pleased and lord it over you. You ought not to be grieved, brothers, because this present time is a season of toil and heat and anxiety and affliction.
2. You have come to him as sons, not as strangers. You ought not to fear when you hear that he is coming.
3. For the good shepherd left the ninety-nine sheep on the mountains and sought the one that had gone astray; and when he found it, he rejoiced over it more than over the ninety-nine.
4. So also our Savior wills that none of the righteous should perish; and he calls all of us, brothers, to repentance through his Son Jesus Christ, our Lord, to whom be the glory and power for ever and ever. Amen.

---

*[Second doxology, appearing in some manuscripts:]*

5. To the only unseen God, the Father of truth, who sent forth to us the Savior and founder of immortality, through whom he also revealed to us the truth and the heavenly life — to him be the glory for ever and ever. Amen.
